query:
SELECT 
  m.id as meeting_id,
  m.timeSlot,
  m.attendeeNumber,
  s.companyName as sponsor,
  CASE m.timeSlot
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Wed 11:00'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Wed 11:30'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Wed 13:15'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Wed 13:45'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Wed 14:30'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Wed 15:00'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'Thu 10:30'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'Thu 11:00'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Thu 13:15'
    WHEN 10 THEN 'Thu 13:45'
    WHEN 11 THEN 'Thu 14:30'
    WHEN 12 THEN 'Thu 15:00'
  END as slot_time,
  CASE m.attendeeId
    WHEN '9322701' THEN 'Tush Wijeratne (WPP)'
    WHEN '93176107633' THEN 'Michelle Monahan'
    WHEN '8196151' THEN 'Mark Kunaseelan'
  END as delegate_name
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId IN ('9322701','93176107633','8196151')
ORDER BY m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot;
